profile.name: 键盘仿真读取器
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件读取组件，用于与键盘仿真式输入源配合，读取原始数据、按块解析内容，并将输入转换为有意义的按键或文本数据。可用于实验中接收扫码器、读码器或其他以键盘输入方式输出的数据流。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software reading component for use with keyboard-emulating input sources. It reads raw data, parses chunked content, and converts the input into meaningful key or text data. It can be used in laboratory workflows to receive data streams from scanners, code readers, or other devices that output as keyboard input.

registry.name: Reader
registry.description: Reader是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、设备连接、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, decode raw data等操作。
